summary.intent: Execute phase 22 (performance-baselines-completion) plans, which had been accidentally committed directly to main instead of a feature branch.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 commits were moved to feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion, main was reset to match origin/main, and wave 1 execution was initiated with 3 parallel subagents (SDK instrumentation, E2E timing tests, load test thresholds).

repo: Phase 22 slug is 'performance-baselines-completion', feature branch convention is feat/phase-{N}-{slug}
GSD branching_strategy for this phase is 'phase', which pre-computes the branch name in init
Phase 22 has 3 plans (22-01, 22-02, 22-03) all in wave 1 (no dependencies between them, safe to parallelize)
workflow: GSD execute-phase workflow: init → clear stale auto-chain → handle branching → validate phase → discover/group plans → execute waves → verify
When planning commits land on main before feature branch exists, the fix is: create branch at current HEAD (capturing the commits), then reset main to origin/main
GSD uses feat/phase-{N}-{slug} naming for execution branches, not docs/ prefix for planning work
The gsd-tools init command returns executor_model, branching_strategy, branch_name, and plan inventory in one call

friction: Phase 22 research and planning commits were accidentally made directly to main instead of a feature branch, requiring a branch reorganization before execution could proceed
GSD's computed branch name (phase-22-performance-baselines-completion) didn't include the feat/ prefix, requiring manual reconciliation with the already-created feat/ branch
open_items: Wave 1 execution (3 parallel agents) was in-flight at transcript end — outcome of 22-01 SDK instrumentation, 22-02 E2E timing tests, and 22-03 load test thresholds not yet known
Commits have not been pushed to origin — feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion exists only locally
